male_pct.evidence_source: Students' sex and baseline levels of depression and anxiety symptoms did not moderate intervention effects on depression symptoms (CDI).

dxgive.evidence_source: Students' sex and baseline levels of depression and anxiety symptoms did not moderate intervention effects on depression symptoms (CDI). Baseline levels of hopelessness significantly moderated intervention effects on depressive symptoms (CDI)
